tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// tshe sgrub nye brgyud kyi sgrub thabs 'chi med grub pa'i zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ dri bral 'gyur med ye shes rdo rje'i sku// tshe lha zhi khro rnga yab gling pa dang*// snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mgon po lcags zam pa// dngos gcig du mar snang des bdag byin rlobs// 'dir grub chen thang stong rgyal pos slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas las dngos su gsan pa'i tshe sgrub nye brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su blang ba'i tshul la gsum ste/ sbyor ba yo byad kyi bshom/ dngos gzhi sgrub pa'i thabs/ byin rlabs dbang gi cho ga'o// dang po ni/ stegs bu'i khar padma 'dab brgyad dam me tog tshom bu bkod pa'i mañdzi la tshe 'brang bum gzugs rta mgos mtshan pa/ de'i g.yas su tshe ril/ g.yon du tshe chang*/ mdun du gtor zlum gnyis sam gsum dang*/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod rnams bsham/ gzhan yang rdor dril me tog sngon gtor sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams tshogs par bya'o// gnyis pa sgrub thabs ni/ rang skad cig gis rta mgrin du bsgoms la/ oṃ hrīḥpadmānta kṛta badzra krodha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum bzlas/ sngon gtor chab kyis bran te/ a kā ro mu khaṃ gyis bsngos/ 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i gtor ma 'di nyid rnal 'byor pas sgrub pa byed pa la bar du gcod par sems pa'i gnod byed dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad la sbyin no// gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la bsam sbyor ngan pa nye bar zhi zhing phan bde'i sems dang ldan par gyis la sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir ma 'dug par gzhan du dengs shig gtor ma phyir btang zhing hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ mchod rdzas a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che dang āḥlas ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa ngo bo bzang zhing dge ba/

bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa/ dus ji srid 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du 'byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung rnam pa thams cad par gyur/ oṃ sarba bitpū ra pū ra sogs dang*/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shabda'i bar/ oṃ badzra dharma ra ṇi tas byin dbab/ rang gi spyi bor skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma tshe dpag med gsal btab la/ skyabs 'gro ma nam mkha' ma nyer gcig gam bdun brjod/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis bla ma zhi khro tshe dpag tu med pa'i sgom bzlas la 'jug par bgyi'o lan gsum/ rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma tshe dpag med la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru ā yur de ba maṇḍa le bhyaḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs kyis rgyun bshags dang tshad med bzhi bsgom/ mdun bskyed rang nyid dbyer med du bskyed pa ni/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid gnas pa'i zhing 'di nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams lag mthil ltar mnyam pa bai ḍūrya'i rang bzhin rin po che sna bdun mchog tu 'bar ba/ bkod legs mdzes shing lta na sdug pa'i dbus su/ rma byas btegs pa'i khri padma dang zla ba'i steng du rang gi sems nyid hrīḥdamar po yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs can/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng du 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'bar ba'i skur gyur pa'i dbu gtsug na rtsa ba'i bla ma/

rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug rje btsun ngag dbang nyi ma/ ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po/ 'jam mgon kun dga' grol mchog kun spangs chos kyi nyi ma/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/ rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po/ mgon po tshe dpag med/ kun bzang snang ba mtha' yas rnams rim bzhin tho brtsegs su bzhugs par gsal ba'i so so'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang de dag las 'od 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad la khyab pas bla tshe yar ba dang 'thor ba nyam chag tu gyur pa rnams dang*/ 'byung ba bzhi'i bcud/ sems can gyi tshe dpal bsod nams/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nyan rang chos srung sogs 'khor 'das thams cad kyi bcud dang dge mtshan rnams bsdus/ brgyud pa rnams la thim/ slar de dag gi sku las 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad bdud rtsis khyab pas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ snang ba mtha' yas 'gro kun rjes su skyong*// tshe dpag med mgon 'gro la 'chi med ster// rta mgrin dbang rgyal 'gro ba'i bar chad sel// padma 'byung gnas snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs// thang stong rgyal por gsol btab bslu ba med// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadzra gu ru padma siddhi puṇye dzñā na ā yuḥsiddhi dzaḥ zhes pa'i rtsa ba'i gsol 'debs sngags dang bcas pa brgya'am nyer gcig sogs brjod cing*/ spro na brgyud 'debs kyang bya ste/ chos sku snang mtha' longs sku zhi khro gnyis// rje btsun rdo rje thod phreng sprul pa'i sku// 'chi med brnyes pa'i grub chen thang stong rgyal// gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol// mkhas btsun grub pa'i sar bzhugs kun spangs rje// 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo grol mchog zhabs// dpal ldan grub rigs 'dzin pa nyi zla'i mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so=

/ngag dbang nyi ma chos kun mkhyen pa'i gter// 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos kun dga' bsod nams dbang*// bstan pa'i srog shing rmor chen rdo rje 'chang*// gsol ba= /ngag gi dbang phyug bsod nams mchog grub zhabs// zab don gdams pa stsol mdzad drin can rje// dngos brgyud dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// gsol ba= /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro yis// mthu dang nus pa'i byin rlabs dpung bskyed la// nad gdon 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang*// tshe dang ye shes 'chi med dngos grub stsol// zhes lan gsum brjod/ gtso bor gong gi sngags ring ba de nyid ci nus bzlas/ mthar gtor ma/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ yam̐ las rlung dang ram̐ las me/ kam̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu'i steng*// a las thod pa dum gcig pa// phyi dkar nang dmar rgya che yangs// dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang*// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ i daṃ ba linta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis dbul/ arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod 'bul/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med// sogs kyis bstod/ 'chi med tshe yi dpal la longs spyod cing*// rig pa'i blo dang rnam dpyod shes rab dang*// srid dang zhi ba'i dpal 'byor ma lus pa// de kun lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes 'dod gsol bya/ gtor ma gnyis pa dpal lcags zam pa'i bstan srung dbang po rnams la phrin las myur mgyogs kyi cho gas 'bul zhing*/ mi shes na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor btang ba'i lag len kyang yod/ gsum pa yod na gzhi bdag spyi gtor gyis bsngo/ mthar/ spyi bo'i rig 'dzin brgyud pa rnams yas rim bzhin 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par gyur/

'chi med gnyug ma'i gnas lugs la mnyam par bzhag dge ba 'di yis myur du 'gro ba rnams// 'chi med rdo rje'i sku mchog rab brnyes nas// yid kyi 'dod pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs mgon nyid du shog /dpon slob mi 'bral lhan cig gnas// sku tshe mi 'gyur sra zhing brtan// ja bzang bzhes spro rgyun mi chad// skyid la chos 'phel bkra shis shog /ces dge ba bsngo zhing shis pa brjod/ tshul des grangs bsnyen 'bum phrag bzhir gsungs kyang de bzhi 'gyur tsam du bzlas na legs par sems shing*/ cho ga'i khrigs gong du smras pa ni/ dbang sgrub dang yon bdag gi rkyen sel tshe chog sogs spros bcas dang bstun pa'i dbang du byas kyi/ gzhan du 'di nyid bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brten pa'i spros med kyi tshe sgrub zab mo'i lugs yin pas bsnyen sgrub dang rgyun khyer gang gi tshe yang mtshan ma'i sgrub rdzas gtor mchod sogs kyi bcas bshom med kyang rung la/ de ltar na mchod pa byin rlabs dang gtor chog kyang mi dgos/ rgyun bshags tshad med bsgom pa'ang yig rnying na med pas/ bsdu na ma byas kyang chog go /gsum pa dbang gi cho ga ni/ bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba'i yi ge logs su bkod pa las shes par byos shig tshe sgrub kun las zab pa'i phul// tshig nyung byin rlabs tshan kha can// snga phyi'i yi ge grangs med las// rang lugs snying por dril 'di'o// sku gsum brgyud pa'i byin rlabs bcud dngar pos// rdo rje'i tshe srog sgrub thabs rmad byung bas// 'khrul med 'jug bde'i khrigs su bsdebs pa'i dge// 'gro kun 'chi bdag bdud las rnam rgyal shog /tshe sgrub nye brgyud kyi sgrub thabs 'chi med grub pa'i zhal lung zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ rang gi nyams len dang*/ don gnyer du mas snga phyir bskul ba'i ngor/ gdams pa 'di'i yi ge rtsa bar gyur pa thams cad mkhyen pa ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs 'chi med dpal ster le lag dang bcas pa'i tshig don gtso bor bzung*/

mkhas grub gong ma'i yi ge dang rigs mthun gyi gzhung gzhan nas kyang cung zad kha bskangs te bstan 'dzin chos rje'i mtshan gyis byin gyis brlabs pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin ye shes lhun grub dpal bzang pos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni skal bzang mkhyen rab kyis bgyis pa'o// ༈ /nye brgyud tshe sgrub kyi tshe 'gugs 'chi med 'od snang bzhugs so/ hrīḥ bdag dang rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i thugs ka nas// 'od kyi zer phreng lcags kyu'i tshogs chen 'phros// srid zhi'i dwangs bcud kun dang khyad par du// bdag dang bsgrub bya'i bla tshe yar dang 'thor// sde brgyad dregs pas khyer ba ma lus kun// 'od kyi sprin phung bdud rtsi'i char rgyun bsil// sku dang yig 'bru thig ler me re re// bdag dang sgrub rdzas rnams la thim par gyur/ hrīḥ 'og min chos dbyings zhing mchog nas// tshe bdag kun bzang snang mtha' yas// thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis brlobs// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadzra gu ru padma siddhi puṇya dzñā na ā yur siddhi dzaḥ bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas// tshe bdag rdo rje tshe dpag med// thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadzra gu ru padma siddhi puṇya dzñā na ā yur siddhi dzaḥ dbang drag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas// tshe bdag khro rgyal rta mchog dpal// thugs rjes bdag= /'chi med tshe yi= oṃ āḥhūm̐= padma 'od kyi pho brang nas// tshe bdag rig 'dzin padma 'byung*// thugs rjes= /'chi med= oṃ āḥhūm̐= 'chi med sgrub gnas ri bo cher// tshe bdag grub chen lcags zam pa// thugs rjes= /'chi med= oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gar bzhugs 'gro 'dul gnas mchog nas// tshe bdag dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs// thugs rjes= /'chi med= oṃ āḥhūm̐= rdo rje lus kyi pho brang nas// tshe bdag yi dam zhi khro'i lha// thugs rjes=

/'chi med= oṃ āḥhūm̐= gnas yul dur khrod brgyad sogs nas// tshe bdag mkha' 'gro dam can tshogs// thugs rjes= /'chi med= oṃ āḥhūm̐= brtan g.yo srid pa'i dwangs bcud dang*// rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dpal// bla tshe yar dang 'thor ba kun// 'dir khug tshe yi gsos su stsol// tshe 'brang 'di la byin cig phob// tshe ril 'di la bcud cig stsol// tshe chang 'di la ngar cig thogs// tshe mda' 'di la rtags cig ston// lus kyi 'byung bzhi nyams pa gsos// sems kyi bde stong nyams rtogs spor// tshe srog chad pa de ring mthud// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadzra gu ru padma siddhi puṇya dzñā na ā yur siddhi dzaḥ zhes pa 'di yang gzhung sa'i sku tshe tshe sgrub rgyun tshugs kyi thun bzhi so sor 'don rgyur blo bzang bstan 'dzin ye shes lhun grub kyis bris pa'o// ༈ /nye brgyud tshe sgrub 'chi med dpal ster gyi dbang chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ā yur de we bhyaḥ skal ldan slob bu'i blo dang thos 'dzin snod// tshe yi smin byed bcud kyis 'gengs 'dod na// sngon med tshig don rmad byung ro bda' ba'i// legs bshad bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'di longs shig nye brgyud tshe sgrub kyi sgo nas slob ma rjes su 'dzin par spro bas bcas bshom sgrub pa dang bcas pa 'chi med sgrub pa'i zhal lung du bshad pa ltar las/ spros pa la dga' na mda' dar yang bshams la bzlas pa'i mjug tu tshe 'gugs 'chi med 'od chags bya zhing*/ las bum spyi ltar bcas pa bsang

spyi bo'i bla ma ma bstims gong dbang chog la 'jug pa ni/ sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid tshang ba'i nang du pad nyi'i gdan la khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa sku mdog dmar po ljang dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ral gri/ g.yon gsum sdigs mdzub mdung thung rgyu zhags 'dzin pa/ dbu'i gtsug na rta mgo ljang gu gsum rta skad 'tsher ba/ zhabs brgyad g.yas bskums zhing g.yon brkyangs pas klu chen po brgyad sbrul gyi rnam par brdzis pa/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan drug mi skra'i tshangs skud sogs khro bo chen po'i rgyan dang rnam 'gyur cha lugs rdzogs pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ rta mgrin zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa bsgoms kyang rung*/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ ha ya grī ba arghaṃ nas shabda a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta khā hi/ rgyal ba kun gyi chos sku padma'i gdung*// chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje chos// spyan ras gzigs sprul hrīḥlas dbang chen sku// rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal lo// bum nang gi lha'i thugs kar hrīḥyig la sngags kyis bskor ba/ bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis bskul bas sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ hrīḥpadmānta kṛta badzra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ brgya'am nyer gcig bzlas mthar lha 'od du zhu nas chur thim pas de'i rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i khro bor gyur pas phrin las mdzad par gyur/ bsdu na bum lha bskyed chog ma byas par chu nyid lha'i ngo bor mos la sngags bzlas pas chog pa brgyud pa 'di pa'i phyag len la yod do// spro na tshe dbang bdag 'jug gi tshul du blangs rjes/

don gnyer gyi slob ma gcig gam mang po'ang rung ste mdun du bsags la ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus bya/ bgegs gtor las bum gyi chu dang ha ya grī wa'i sngags kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs par gtor ma 'dod dgu 'byung bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba bhū ta ā karṣā ya dzaḥ a kā ro lan gsum/ bden brdar gyi mthar/ khyad par du yang bla ma zhi khro sku gsum tshe yi lha tshogs rnams kyi/ bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la bla ma zhi khro'i tshe yi dbang bskur sgrub pa la bar du gcod par sems pa'i gnod byed dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la bsam sbyor ngan pa nye bar zhi zhing phan bde'i sems dang ldan pas gnas 'dir ma 'dug par gzhan du dengs shig gal te mi 'gro na khro bo'i ye shes kyi rdo rje rab tu 'bar bas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro// oṃ suṃ bha ni brjod/ oṃ badzra rakṣa hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ steng rdo rje'i gur khang*/ logs rdo rje'i rwa ba/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo cis kyang mi shigs par gyur/ ༈ /swa sti siddhaṃ/ de yang chos 'di'i lugs kyis shes bya la kha tshon gcod pa'i tshe dngos po gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad snang stong dbyer med lhag pa chos kyi skur sangs rgyas pa zhig yin na'ang de ltar mi rtogs te 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por rang rgyud gzung 'dzin gyi zhags pas bcings pa'i sems can 'di thams cad pha mar ma gyur pa med pas thar pa bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos gsan snyam pa'i thugs bskyed dang chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa'i sher phyin sdud pa las/

dga' dang gus dang dad pa'i mchog ni nyer bzhag ste// sgrib pa nyon mongs bsal nas dri ma las 'das pa// 'gro don mngon zhugs des pa'i shes rab pha rol phyin// gang la dpa' rnams spyod pa 'di ni mnyan par gyis// zhes gsungs pa ltar dga' ba dang*/ gus pa dang*/ dad pa bskyed nas/ gnyid rmugs la sogs pa'i sgrib pa dang*/ nga rgyal la sogs pa'i dri ma rnams spangs la/ tshe 'di'i blo ngan dri ma can las 'das pa thar pa kho na la dmigs pas/ sems can gyi don du ngas chos 'di nyan la rgyud la phan pa zhig bya snyam du mos 'dun rtse gcig pas gsan par zhu/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ mthun par gyur pa'i yul du gnas pa dang*// skyes bu dam pa la ni bstan pa dang*// bdag nyid legs smon sngon yang bsod nams bgyis// 'khor lo chen po bzhi ni khyod la mnga'// zhes phun sum tshogs pa du ma dang ldan pa'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka' zhing rnyed pa don chen po dang ldan pa yin te/ zhi ba lhas/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'// skyes bus don sgrub thob par gyur pa las// da res 'di la phan pa ma bsgrubs na// phyis 'di yang dag 'byor par ga la 'gyur// zhes dang*/ slob dpon tsand+ra go mīs/ gang zhig thob nas skye ba'i rgya mtsho mthar 'byin cing*// byang chub mchog gi sa bon dge ba'ang 'debs gyur pa// yid bzhin nor bu bas kyang yon tan lhag pa yi// mi nyid de ni su zhig 'bras bu med par byed// ces gsungs/ de ltar thob pas mi chog spyir khams gsum gyi 'gro ba phal mo cher tshe tshad kyi nges pa re bshad cing*/ bye brag mir gyur pa la yang mdzod las/ sgra mi snyan na lo stong ste// gnyis na phyed kyis dman pa'o// zhes byang gling par lo stong*/ shar gling par lnga brgya/ nub gling par nyis brgya lnga bcu'i tshad bzung bshad kyang*/

sgra mi snyan ma gtogs phal cher la dus min gyi 'chi ba yod/ khyad par rang cag 'dzam bu gling pa rnams la ni/ 'di na ma nges mtha' mar ni// lo bcu dang po dpag tu med// ces pa ltar bskal pa dang po tshe lo dpag med thub pa nas mtha' ma tshe lo bcur 'dus pas mtshon 'phel 'grib shin tu che zhing deng sang snyigs ma mthar thug par nye ba'i phyir glo bur du 'chi ba'i rkyen dang bar chad shin tu mang ba yin te/ tshe 'di gnod mang rlung gis btab pa yi// chu yi chu bur bas kyang mi rtag na// dbugs dbyung dbugs rngub gnyid kyis log pa las// sad khom gang lags de ni ngo mtshar che// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// des na slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas/ 'khor bar srog las gces pa ni// gang yang yod pa ma yin te// de bas myur du thabs mang pos// 'chi ba bslu ba kun tu gces// zhes dang*/ brtse med 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las// thar pa'i thabs ni 'bad de bya// gang phyir 'dir ni yid 'ong ba// srog las gzhan pa yod ma yin// zhes dang*/ chos spyod dbang po dul ba ni// 'khor ba ru ni ji srid 'tsho// de srid bsod nams la sogs tshogs// byang chub sgrub byed rab tu skye// mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma las/ sdug bsngal gyis ni sems g.yengs na// g.yengs bas dngos grub gzhan du 'gyur// lus dang sems can brtan gyur na// bde ba thams cad brtan par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ sems can tshe ni thung ba yis// dngos grub 'grub pa gang yang med// de bas rnal 'byor bzang po kun// tshe ring ba ni dge ba'o// zhes spyir lus can thams cad gces pa'i mthar thug pa ni rang gi srog yin la/ khyad par dge ba byed pa rnams tshe ring du gnas par gyur na de srid du bsod nams ye shes kyi tshogs gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'gyur/ de'i nang nas gsang sngags kyi zab mo'i lam sgom pa rnams kyang dngos grub rnam pa gnyis sgrub pa'i rten lus kyi zungs dang sems kyi rten tshe ring ba kho na gal che bas rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis bya ba dang byed pa thams cad kyi sngon du tshe spel ba'i thabs la 'bad par mdzad dgos/

de ltar tshul bzhin 'bad na blo dang brtson 'grus kyi stobs dang skal pa rab tu gyur pa rnams kyis 'chi ba med pa'i gnas mngon du byed nus/ 'bring dang tha mas kyang tshe ring du 'phel ba'am dus min gyi 'chi ba bzlog nas tshe dus su bsring bar nus pa gdon mi za ste/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i rtog pa las/ 'chi bdag rnams kun bslu ba ni// grol ba nyid la rigs pa yin// ma grol ba ni thams cad kyi// cung zad dus su bsring ba yin// zhes dang*/ mar dang snying po zad sogs kyis// mar me la sogs 'jig phyogs la// slar yang 'bru mar la sogs pas// bskal pa'i bar du gnas pa yin// de bzhin du ni lus 'di yang*// rgas sogs kyis ni 'chi bzhin pa// grub pa'i man ngag legs rnyed na// bskal pa'i bar yang cis mi gnas// dper na khang pa rnying pa dag /bcos pa yis ni yun ring gnas// de bzhin rnying pa'i lus dag kyang*// bcos pas gnas par cis mi 'gyur// zhes bshad/ 'o na tshe sring ba'i thabs ji lta bu yin zhe na/ snga ma las/ lus dang ngag gi las kyis phyi// bsam gtan las kyis nang gi yin// nor bu sngags sman phyi yin te// rnal 'byor rig pa nang yin no// zhes pa ltar phyi nor bu dang sngags dang sman dang bcud len gyi nus pas tshe bsring ba dang*/ theg pa thun mong pa'i lugs la gser 'od dam pa'i mdo las/ tshe ring ba'i rgyu ni gnyis yin te/ srog gcod pa spangs pa dang*/ gzhan la kha zas rab tu sbyin pa'o// zhes rgyal po la sogs pa stobs dang ldan pa rnams kyis rang gi mnga' ris su gtogs pa'i srog chags rnams la ri rgya klung rgya sdom pa sogs mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyis sgo nas sbyin pa dang*/ nad pa rnams la zas gos dang*/ sman pa dang*/ nad g.yog sbyor ba/ mgon med pa rnams kyi dpung gnyen byed pa sogs rnams pa du mas phan gdags pa dang*/ rgyal ba'i sku gzugs dang*/ mchod rten dang*/

dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra ba sogs rnying pa gso zhing gsar du bskrun pa dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ dge 'dun dang*/ pha ma rgan rabs sogs mchod cing bkur sti bya ba dang*/ gsung rab bklag cing satstsha 'debs pa sogs kyis bsod nams spel ba dang*/ mchod sbyin rgya chen po ma 'grub na sbyin pa rnam bzhi'i don tshang ba'i bsil gtor brgya rtsa mang du btang ba sogs kyis kyang tshe 'phel bar bshad la/ rdo rje theg pa ni thabs mang ba yin pas lha'i rnal 'byor dang*/ sngags dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ dbang bskur dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/ 'khrul 'khor dang*/ rten 'brel sna tshogs pas tshe spel ba'i thabs gsungs pa rnams kyi nang nas da lam gyi skabs 'dir lhag pa'i lha'i byin rlabs dbang bskur gyi sgo nas sku tshe spel ba skabs su babs/ de la rtog pa dang ldan pa'i rgyud la yid ches kyi nges pa bskyed pa'i phyir phyogs gang du gtogs ngos bzung ba dang*/ gang las byung ba brgyud pa'i lo rgyus/ brgyud pa de las byung ba'i dbang bskur gyi cho ga rnams go rim bzhin ston par byed pa las dang po ni/ 'o skol gyi ston pa shākya thub pa shākya seng ge shākya'i rgyal po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa des gdul bya so so'i blo'i rim pa dang bstun nas chos kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bka' stsal pa rnams kyang bsdu na theg pa che chung gnyis su 'dus pa las 'dir theg pa chen po yin/ de la yang rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi theg pa gnyis las/ 'dir gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yin/ de yang nang gses su rgyud sde gong 'og gi rnam grangs dbye bsdu mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig yod kyang rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud// bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la// sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la// zhes pa ltar yongs su grags pa rgyud sde chen po bzhi las 'dir rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa yin/

de lta bu'i gsang sngags nang pa bla med kyi chos la rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du rgyud so so'i bshad tshul dang brgyud pa tha dad pa tsam las gsar rnying du phye ba'i tha snyad grags pa med kyang*/ gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan yab sras dang ral pa can sogs kyi sku'i ring la paṇḍi ta chen po padma saṃ bha ba dang*/ bi ma la mi tra/ shāntiṃ garbha sogs spyan drangs/ lo chen bai ro/ rma gnyags ska cog sogs kyis rje 'bangs skal ba mchog dang ldan pa kho na'i ngor bsgyur bshad 'chad nyan gyis gtan 'bebs mdzad pa rnams la sngags rnying ma dang*/ de 'og rgyal po dar mas bstan pa nyams dmad pa'i rjes su paṇḍi ta smṛ ti dang*/ lo chen rin bzang man chad kyis bsgyur ba la sngags gsar ma zhes grags pa las/ 'dir grub chen nag po spyod pa'i rnam 'phrul rong zom chos bzang sogs kyi gsung las gsar ma las spyan 'dren pa po/ yon bdag gang du bsgyur ba'i gnas/ sgyur byed kyi lo paṇa/ zhu rten me tog brjod bya chos te che ba drug gis khyad par 'phags pa'i lugs de la'ang thams cad kyi rtsa ba'am rgyal po lta bu bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba 'chi ba med pa'i dngos grub stsol ba la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rje gcig tu gyur pa de la dkyil 'khor dang sgrub thabs kyi bye brag mtha' yas pa zhig bzhugs pa'i nang tshan grub chen lcags zam pa zhes mtshan nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa de nyid kyis slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas las dngos su gsan pa'i tshe sgrub nye brgyud du grags pa de'i dbang 'bul ba yin lags/ gnyis pa brgyud pa'i lo rgyus ni/ rang gter lung bstan kun gsal nyi 'od las/ mi nyag rig 'dzin ldong gi bu// skyes bu mtshan bzang glang lo pa// gzugs byad skye mtha'i byang chub sems// thugs rje yum gyi lhums nas 'khrungs// mdog smug dri zhim sme bas brgyan// ngang rgyud dal zhing rig rtsal che// ma nges spyod pa sna tshogs skyong*// lo bdun lon nas brgyad cu'i bar// thos bsam bsgom zhing brtul zhugs spyod// shākya'i tshul 'dzin gsang sngags spyod// ḍā ki ma lus dbang du sdud// rgyal bas dbyings nas dbang bskur mdzad// sbas pa'i ngang nas 'gro don mdzad// zab dang rgya che'i chos rnams spyod// nang rtags ya mtshan ston pa 'byung*// de ni yid bzhin nor bu'i sku// gang gis mthong thos don chen 'grub// ces sogs dang*/

padma gling pa'i gter yig las kyang*/ o rgyan sprul pa thang stong pa zhes 'byungaḥ /de dus bod khams sems can cung zad bdeḥ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhi khro dang*/ slob dpon chen po padma/ grub thob tilli pa dang*/ ku ku ri pa rnams kyi thugs rje'i zlos gar grub chen lcags zam pa g.yas ru la stod byang gi rin chen ldings zhes bya ba'i yul grong du mi nyag gi rus las yab rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang*/ yum rgya gar lha mo zhes bya ba'i sras su rab byung drug pa'i lcags mo glang gi lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bcu la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te sku bltams/ dgung lo lnga par kun spangs ri khrod pa las rdzogs chen dang ro snyoms gcod kyi skor sogs gsan pas gnas lugs kyi don ji bzhin du gzigs/ sku lus du mar sprul nas sa dang chu'i steng du 'byon pa sogs kyi rdzu 'phrul dang ting nge 'dzin dus de nyid nas mnga' 'byor/ yi ge 'bri klog dang rtsis la sogs pa rtsol med du mkhyen/ thugs rje chen po'i bkas dngos su bskul te bla ma nyi ma seng ge'i drung du rab tu byung zhing*/ bka' lnga pa dpal 'byor shes rab las bsnyen par rdzogs/ mkhas pa blo gros rdo rje las tshad ma rnam 'grel dang*/ slob dpon dkon mchog dar las mngon rtogs rgyan gsan pas mtshon ngams ring chos sde dang*/ dpal ldan sa skya pa/ bzang ldan mnga' ris shel dkar rnams su phar tshad 'dul mngon dbu ma sogs la thugs sbyong mdzad/ chos rje bka' lnga pa dang*/ mchog bzang legs pa'i blo gros/ byang sems nyi ma seng ge/ chos rje bsam 'grub rgyal mtshan/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ mched zla bla ma grags bzang pa/ re mda' pa gzhon nu blo gros/ lha gdong pa bsod nams mchog byang sems sbyin pa bzang po/ sa skya pa kun dga'i mtshan/ jo nang pa chos dpal mgon/ sgrub pa po bzang po dpal/ grub chen rgyal dbang pa/

gru chen bzang po skyong*/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ kun mkhyen sbud kra ba/ gyem pa bka' bzhi pa nam mkha' 'od zer/ mkhas pa lung mang po sogs bod yul gyi mkhas grub du ma la bde kye/ dus 'khor/ gsang 'dus/ dmar nag 'jigs gsum/ sgyu 'phrul/ blo sbyong*/ zhi byed/ gcod yul/ phyag chen chos drug lam 'bras/ sbyor drug rdzogs chen/ bka' 'gyur ro cog gi lung sogs kha ba can na grags pa'i mdo sngags gsar rnying bka' gter gyi chos tshul phal mo che legs par gsan/ paṇḍi ta ma hā bo ddhi dang*/ siddhi ratna sogs rgya gar dang bal po'i mkhas grub dus der phal pa'i spyod yul du gyur pa kha cig dang*/ rdo rje 'chang*/ thub pa'i dbang po/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ thugs rje chen po/ gnas brtan yan lag 'byung*/ sha ba ri/ bi rū pa/ padma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ne gu ma/ ma cig lab sgron sogs sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin grub thob ye shes kyi sku can rnams las mdo sngags kyi zab don gdams pa mtha' yas pa gsan pa bcas yongs dril bla ma dam pa brgya phrag lnga'i gsung gi bdud rtsis thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gang*/ dben gnas thar pa gling du lo drug dang*/ gzhan yang rgya bod kyi gnas mang por rim gnyis zab mo'i lam bsgom pa la brtson par mdzad pas thugs dam gyi lha dang sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pa'i zhal gzigs/ bde drod dang ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo sogs mngon par rtogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'khrungs/ bzang ngan gyi rkyen rnams ro snyoms/ 'byung ba bzhi la rang dbang thob/ rdzu 'phrul mngon shes rgya chen po brnyes/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong lha srin sde brgyad bran du 'khol ba sogs bdag don spangs rtogs kyi yon tan mthar son pas gzhan don bla ma dam pa brgya phrag lnga las gsan pa'i chos rnams bka' babs chen po brgyad du bsdus pa'i gdams pas snod ldan rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/

gsung yi ge drug ma'i chos 'khor bskor ba sogs gang la gang 'dul gyi phrin las spyi dang*/ khyad par rdo rje phag mo/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ o rgyan chen po sogs kyis lung bstan ltar gru dang zam pa/ lcags zam 'dzugs pa/ sa'i me btsa' gtsug lag khang dang rten gsum bzhengs pa/ gnas sgo 'byed pa sogs skye rgu spyi dang*/ khyad par gangs can gyi bstan 'gro spyi la sman pa'i thabs tshul 'ba' zhig lhur mdzad pa'i rnam thar bka' drin bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni phul byung rab brtags kyi bsngags pa brjod pa tsam ma yin par phyag ris dang byin rlabs kyi tshan kha mchog dman thams cad kyi gzigs lam du dngar ba 'di lags/ de ltar bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mtshan brtson 'grus bzang po/ rgyal sde'i thang du mkha' 'gro sde lngas mtshan re gsol ba'i gtso bos/ khyab gdal chen po'i thaṃng chen na// stongaṃ nyid rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// 'jigs med rgyalaṃ poṃ lta bur bzhugs// de phyir thang stong rgyal por thogs// zhes ye shes kyi mkha' 'gros gsol ba'i mtshan thang stong rgyal po/ rtogs pa'i yon tan mdzad pa'i cha las bla dwags su grags pa'i mtshan grub thob lcags zam pa chen po gang des/ bod dang*/ bal po/ rgya gar/ kha che/ rgya nag sogs 'dzam bu gling gi sa'i khyon phal mo che dang*/ zangs gling dang*/ siṅga la dang*/ zla ba'i gling sogs gling phran mang po zhabs kyis bcags/ skabs shig na rnga yab laṅka'i gling du 'byon par bzhed nas/ rgya gar nub phyogs kyi mthar gshegs pa na rgya mtsho chen por nor bu len pa'i tshong pa 'ga' zhig gzings bcas te 'gro bar gzigs/ de rnams la nged rnga yab gling du 'gro ba yin pas gru la sgrol ba'i rogs dan gyis zhes gsungs pa na/ de rnams na re/ nged cag rnams rin chen len pa yin la/ gling der rdzu 'phrul dang mi ldan pas bgrod par mi nus shing*/ rdzu 'phrul cung zad yod pas bgrod kyang srog gi bar chad du 'gro bas khyod rang yang 'di nas log pa 'thad ces gru la 'jug tu ma 'dod/

der mtsho 'gram du khyi lpags stan la bzhugs nas sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin bsgoms shing*/ khyad par du mtsho'i nang grangs med pa'i sems can sdug bsngal myong bar gzigs pa rnams la thugs snying rje chen pos 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs bzhin bzhugs pa na klu chen po brgyad 'ongs te rin po che sna tshogs phul nas chos nyan/ klu rnams kyis bsu ba byas te skad cig la rnga yab gling du phyag phebs pa nas gling de'i ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa rnams mngon sum gzigs/ khyad par gling de'i nub byang ngos nas rin po che'i ri chen po rtse mo gsum pa'i g.yas phyogs na sangs rgyas 'od dpag med dang*/ g.yon phyogs su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi chos gsungs/ dbus kyi ri tsitta'i dbyibs 'dra ba'i rtse mor padma 'od kyi gzhal med khang chen po'i dbus su slob dpon chen po padma rgyal po'i cha lugs rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gsang sngags zab mo'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i zhabs drung du byon/ phyag 'tshal zhing yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod pa na/ o rgyan chen pos sgrub pa chen po sde drug 'chi med tshe dang bcas pa'i sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ khyad par bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brten pa'i tshe sgrub zab mo 'di nyid stsal/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyis zhal gzigs/ ri de'i mdun du padma'i sdong po chen po gsum sgrig gi dbus ma'i rtse mor slob dpon chen po padma rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can dang*/ g.yon phyogs bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong dang*/ nye ba'i sras brgyad/ rdo rje phag mo/ gtso bor steng gi nam mkhar dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bzhugs pa la lha mis mchod pa 'bul bar gzigs/ slob dpon chen pos zhu ba'i tshul mdzad nas dpal rdo rje sems dpa' las rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud rnams gsan/ gzhan yang gling der ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i 'du bar lhan cig spyod pa mdzad pa na kla klo 'dul ba dang*/

gnas sgo 'byed pa sogs kyi lung bstan dang phrin las sgrub par g.yar dam phul ba yin te/ gsol 'debs las/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling du phebs pa'i tshe// padma 'byung gnas rgyal po'i cha lugs can// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro du mas bskor ba las// sgrub chen bka' brgyad la sogs gsan la 'dud// sangs rgyas stong sogs yi dam du ma gzigs// khyad par ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' la// o rgyan chen pos zhu ba mdzad byas nas// bla med rdzogs pa chen po gsan la 'dud// ces re zhig gling der bzhugs par bzhed kyang*/ mkha' 'gro rnams kyis nan tan du bskul nas rdzu 'phrul rlung gi nus pas ring por ma yin par bod yul du phyag phebs/ dus der slob dpon chen po las dngos su gsan pa'i tshe sgrub zab mo 'di nyid thugs nyams su bzhes pa la brten nas grub chen nyid kyis lcags mo glang nas shing sbrul gyi bar lo brgya dang nyi shu rtsa brgyad bzhugs/ slob ma'ang dgung lo brgya phrag brgal ba'i tshe la dbang 'byor ba mang du byung bar grags/ grub chen nyid la slob ma'i tshogs mtha' yas kyang*/ 'dir brgyud pa 'ded rgyu rdo ring kun spangs pa dang*/ bshes gnyen bkra shis bzang po zung la stsal/ de gnyis ka la 'jam mgon grol mchog gis gsan/ de la ngag dbang nyi zla bzang pos gsan nas de yan chad gsung rgyun yi ge med pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa las/ dpal ngag gi dbang phyug nyi zla bzang pos tshe sgrub nye brgyud kyi lo rgyus/ nye brgyud ngo bo/ nye brgyud 'chi med dpal ster zhes pa'i yi ge gsum mdzad pa lugs 'di'i gzhung rtsa ba lta bu yin zhing*/ de nas bzung tshe sgrub 'chi med dpal ster du grags/ phyis cho ga zor yang zhing byin rlabs che bas grub mtha' ris su ma chad pa'i bla ma rnams kyis phyag len du mdzad pas lhag par zab cing dbang chog sogs yig cha yang shin tu mang bar mngon/ brgyud pa'ang mi 'dra ba du ma yod mod/

gtso che ba ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po nas sger pa rje btsun ngag dbang nyi ma/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ ra ba smad mkhan chen ngag dbang bsod nams mchog grub/ de la kho bos zhus shing*/ yang na ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po nas/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ kun gzigs lnga pa chen po/ chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa/ mang thos pa tshe dbang mi 'gyur rdo rje/ des kho bo la dgyes pas stsal ba'i brgyud pa rnam par dag pa yin/ gzhan yang kun mkhyen lnga pa chen po la rje grub chen nas stsal ba rgya can nang gi rigs lnga 'chi med mchog sbyin dang*/ rig 'dzin chen po chos rje gling pa'i dag snang tshe dbang lo brgya mar grags pa gnyis kyang gdams pa'i ngo bo gcig cing kho bos legs par thob pa'i phyir/ nye brgyud kyi byin rlabs kyang chu bo gnyis 'dres su bzhugs pa lags/ brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa la bdag don du tshe sgrub pa dang*/ gzhan don du dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ 'dir dbang bskur gyi cho ga sgrub pa la slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams sngon du grub/ khyed rang rnams kyi sku'i ngo skal du gyur pa la/ thog mar bla ma tshe dpag med dngos su gsal ba la tshe dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de nas dbang gi slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul ston pa// mgon po chen por bdag phyag 'tshal// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// de nas bla ma tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i steng gi char/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi mtha' skor du rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa sprin phung chen po gtibs pa ltar mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa dang*/

dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ don dam pa dang*/ kun rdzob kyi sems bskyed pa/ dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo ba sogs tshig phyir thugs gzhol bas 'di'i rjes zlos/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces sdom pa gsum ma thob pa rnams gsar du thob/ thob pa rnams gong du 'phel bas dbang gi snod du rung ba'i dgos pa yod do// gsum pa dbang gi gzhi dgod pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ zhes brjod pas chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa sems nyid 'od gsal ba'i gnas lugs la blo bzhag stong pa'i ngang las sa phyogs 'di dag nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams lag mthil ltar mnyam pa bai ḍūrya'i rang bzhin sna bdun mchog tu 'bar ba bkod legs mdzes shing lhun stug pa'i dbus su rma byas btegs pa'i khri padma dang zla ba'i steng du/ khyed rang rnams kyi rig pa'i ngo bo hrī dmar po yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha lugs can/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng na 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'bar ba'i skur gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/

mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i cha stod du zla gdan la thugs srog hrīḥdamar po'i khog par rang gi tshe'i 'od kyi thig le dkar po dang bcas pa gsal 'debs pa zhu/ bla ma dang rgyal ba tshe dpag med gnyis su med pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i rnam par nyi zer gyi rdul 'khrigs pa'am/ kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa tsam byon nas bdag nyid la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas// bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas rnams// rang byung ye shes brda' yis rgyud bskul te// phyag rgya rol pa'i gar gyis spyan 'dren na// lhun grub gzhal yas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// lhun grub gzhal yas gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang*// 'dir tshogs skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la// 'chi med rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadzra gu ru padma siddhi puṇye dzñā na ā yu siddhi dzaḥ dzñā na ā be sha ya a āḥ de ltar spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rnams khyed rang dang ro gcig tu sangs rgyas ma thob bar brtan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ su pra tiṣṭhas me tog 'thor/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ gang las dbang blang ba'i yul gsal gdab cing tshe 'gugs pa/ tshe'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du blang ba/ mtha' rten dngos grub kyi rdzas sbyin pa/ dbang don brtan par bya ba rnams su yod pa las/ dang po ni/ khyed rang rnams mgon po tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i spyi bor dbang skur ba po'i bla ma dang dbang rten tshe bum gnyis su med pa bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa sku mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'bar ba'i dbu gtsug tu rtsa ba'i bla ma/

de'i dbu gtsug tu ngag dbang bsod nams mchog grub/ de'i dbu gtsug tu rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug rje btsun ngag dbang nyi ma/ ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po/ 'jam mgon kun dga' 'grol mchog rdo ring kun spangs chen po/ de man chad sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i cha lugs can/ phyag na 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po lo brgya lon pa'i tshul can phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi steng 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas za hor ma yongs grags ltar dang*/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs gsang sgrub kyi rnam 'gyur ltar ram/ yang na sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas dbyug to 'phyar zhing g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub/ dbu gtsug na rta zhal 'tsher ba khro bo'i rnam pa can/ mgon po tshe dpag med/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas rnams tho brtsegs su bzhugs par gsal ba'i so so'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par thim pas bla ma de rnams skyabs gnas kun 'dus su gyur par mos/ de nas tshe 'gug pa'i slad du spyi bor bzhugs pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma de rnams kyi sku las tshe'i lha mo lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog dril bu thogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par spros pa rnams kyis khyed rang rnams kyi bla tshe 'phrog pa/ 'khyams pa/ yar ba/ 'chi bdag gshin rje rgyal bsen sogs bgegs rig stong phrag brgyad cu dang*/ ban bon mthu bo che rnams kyis brkus pa/ 'phrog pa/ gzhom pa/ phyi nang gi 'byung ba dgra gshed du 'khrugs pas nyams pa/ zad pa/ 'thor ba thams cad a dang nṛ sogs tshe srog gi yig 'bru dang*/ bla gzugs kyi srog chags/ bkra shis rdzas rtags la sogs pa'i rnam par rang dbang med par bkug ste khyed rang rnams kyi thugs ka'i hrīḥyig tshe'i thig le dang bcas par bstims pas bla dang tshe srog nyams pa thams cad sor chud de 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/

hrīḥbacom ldan mgon po sogs/ gnyis pa dbang bskur ba dngos la khyed rang rnams kyi dbu gtsug na bzhugs pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la/ bdag la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub stsal du gsol snyam du mos gus drag pos gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥ snang ba mtha' yas 'gro kun rjes su skyong*// nas sngags lan gsum/ spro na brgyud 'debs kyang brjod/ zhes gsol ba btab pas spyi bo'i rig 'dzin brgyud pa rnams kyi sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi bla tshe yar ba 'thor ba nyams chags su gyur pa bdud dang gshin rje sogs gdon bgegs kyis 'phrogs shing sbas pa rnams dang*/ tshe 'phel zhing brtan par byed nus pa'i brtan g.yo snod bcud sa chu me rlung nam mkha' ste 'byung ba bzhi'i khams spyi dang*/ nor bu/ 'bru/ sman/ bcud len sogs kyi dwangs bcud/ skye 'gro mtha' dag gi tshe dpal bsod nams nus stobs sogs bkra shis dge legs/ khyad par lha klu gnod sbyin grub pa sogs tshe bskal par gnas pa rnams kyi tshe bcud bkrag dang gzi mdangs/ nub phyogs bde ba can dang padma 'od sogs dag pa'i zhing rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i bla ma sku gsum tshe'i lha tshogs gtso bor gyur pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa nyan rang mkha' 'gro chos srung rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa thams cad rdo khab len gyis lcags phye blangs pa'am/ bung bas me tog gi bcud blangs pa ltar 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi'i rnam par 'od zer gyi sne la 'ub kyis bsdus/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi sku la thim/ de dag gi sku las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi kha dog lnga ldan gyi rgyun chad pa med par babs pas khyed rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ spyi mgrin snying lte'i rtsa 'khor gyi gnas rnams rim bzhin gang ste/

mthar lus thams cad bdud rtsis ltems mer gyis gang bas tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sgo gsum dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag 'chi med tshe'i dbang bzhi thob cing nam yang gzhom gzhig med pa rdo rje'i tshe srog mngon du byas pa'i thugs mos mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥ snang ba mtha' yas sogs sngags dang bcas brjod/ gsum pa mtha' rten dngos grub kyi rdzas sbyin pa ni/ thabs kyi rdzas bcud len tshe'i ril bu 'di nyid phyag g.yas su byin pas thabs bde ba chen po mchog tu 'gyur ba med pa rdo rje tshe'i dbang thob pa'i thugs mos/ dpon slob mi 'bral/ rang sngags/ shes rab kyi rdzas bdud rtsi'i btung ba 'di nyid phyag g.yon du byin pas shes rab stong pa nyid cis kyang mi gshigs pa rdo rje tshe'i dbang thob pa'i thugs mos/ 'di ni bla ma lhag pa'i lha// dam can rgya mtsho thams cad kyi// 'khor 'das kun gyi bcud bsdus pa'i// 'chi med bdud rtsi grub pa'i rdzas// reg pas rkyen kun sel byed cing*// myangs pas 'chi med go 'phang thob// bcud pas rtag brtan g.yung drung sku// brnyes byed 'chi med bdud rtsi 'bul// rang sngags/ tshar grangs gsog na/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ spyi bo'i bla ma rnams kyi sku las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad la khyab pas nas/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob pa'i mos pa mdzod kyi bar mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥ snang ba mtha' yas sogs dang*/ tshe ril tshe chang sngags kho nas sbyin pa la grangs 'dzin/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi tshe mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung lta bur gyur cig mi shigs pa rdo rje lta bur gyur cig mi nub pa rgyal mtshan lta bur gyur cig 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub thob par gyur cig ces me tog dor/ bzhi pa byin rlabs brtan par bya ba ni/ de ltar dbang thob pas tshe nyams pa gsos/ chad pa mthud/ yar ba 'dus nas 'chi med kyi dngos grub thob par gyur pa de nyid mi 'gyur zhing brtan pa'i phyir du spyi bo'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/

'chi med tshe yi dpal la longs spyod cing*// rig pa'i blo dang rnam dpyod shes rab dang*// srid dang zhi ba'i dpal 'byor gang lags pa// de kun lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas spyi bo'i bla ma rnams yas rim bzhin dgyes pa chen pos 'od kyi rnam par ldem ldem zhu nas slob dpon tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba la thim/ de yang 'od zer gyi phung por zhu ste khyed rang rnams tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i thugs srog hrīḥyig tshe yi thig le dang bcas pa la thim pas bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi sku gsung thugs dang*/ khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du 'dres nas snying ga'i tshe rten 'od kyi thig le dkar la 'tsher ba snum la 'dril ba gang gis kyang mi chod mi shigs pa'i rang bzhin du gyur par dmigs pa rtse gcig tu gtad cing*/ mthar dus gsum gyi kun rtogs bcos sgyur sgom byed kyi 'dzin pa'i sgrib g.yogs dang bral ba skye 'chi med pa'i ye shes ka dag phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ tshul de la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'chi med rig 'dzin grub pa'i tshogs chen po nam mkha'i khyon gang pa rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu bkra shis pa'i glu dbyangs len zhing mandā ra ba'i me tog gi char phab ste rab tu gnas par mdzad pa'i thugs mos gnang bar zhu/ yin lugs don la sogs brjod/ des dbang gi dngos gzhi grub nas rjes kyi cho ga la dam tshig bsdus nas khas blang ba dang*/ yon phul zhing dge ba bsngo ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de ltar dbang thob pa tsam gyis mi chog dam tshig bsrung dgos/ ji ltar bsrung tshul theg pa bla na med pa'i rgyud 'grel las bshad pa'i dam tshig gi rim pa spyi dang*/ khyad par 'chi ba bslu ba'i rtog pa las/ rkun ma nya dang ri dwags sbrul// bya sogs srog ni 'dod pa rnams// 'di dag bsad na 'phral du ni// tshe ring ba yang tshe thung 'gyur// zhes pa ltar tshe thung ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo gzhan gyi srog gcod pa kho na yin pas nan tan du spong ba dang*/

tshe sgrub kyi gzhung gzhan las/ ci 'byor tshe srog bslus pa dpral ba ru// nyi zla'i rtags gdab phyin chad srog mi bcad// srog mi bcad pa'i khas blangs sdom pa sbyin// zhes sems can 'chi nges kyi srog bslu ba la ci nus su 'bad pa gal che bas de rnams la bsrung sdom bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso bos ji ltar/ gnyis pa ni/ de ltar legs par thob pa'i gtang rag gi ched du maṇḍal 'bul ba zhu/ slar lus longs spyod dge tshogs rgya mtsho dang bcas pa 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyi 'byor pa ltar 'bul na cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ deng nas brtsams te/ des rgyal ba'i dbang po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa la rgyud sde gong 'og dang sngags gsar rnying las byung ba'i sgrub thabs kyi srol kha rgyas bsdus grangs kyis mi lang ba lta bu bzhugs pa'i nang nas grub chen lcags zam pa chen pos slob dpon chen po padma las dngos su gsan pa'i tshe sgrub nye brgyud 'chi med dpal ster gyi dbang legs par phul grub pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad pa dang*/ de las byung ba'i dge tshogs kyang sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub chen por yongs su bsngo ba zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs/ dpon slob mi 'bral sogs brjod la slob ma bkye/ mchod pa kha gsos byin gyis brlab/ oṃ gu ru ā yu rde ba sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod 'bul/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med// sogs kyis bstod/ 'chi med tshe yi dpal la longs spyod cing*// sogs kyis 'dod don gsol/ yig brgya lan bdun nam gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs kyi nongs pa bshags/ 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs kyis rten la brtan bzhugs khyed kyis sems can sogs kyis gtor mgron 'jig rten pa gshegs/

bla brgyud rnams snying ga'i tshe rten la bstims nas bla ma rang sems dbyer med kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag slar yang thun mtshams kyi lha skur langs la dge bsngo shis brjod ci rigs bya zhing*/ las rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o// nye brgyud tshe sgrub kyi dbang chog phyis kyi phyag len ltar cung zad spros pas brgyan pa 'di'ang don gnyer du mas snga phyir bskul ngor/ bstan 'dzin chos rje'i mtshan gyis byin gyis brlabs pa ye shes lhun grub bam/ ming gzhan dpal ldan bde chen rnam rol 'chi med grub pa'i dbang phyug gis sbyar bas bdag gzhan 'gro kun 'chi med stobs bcu'i go 'phang la reg cing*/ yab rje grub pa'i dbang po'i bstan srid rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
